bio: This appealing restaurant in Wilmersdorf is dedicated to Lebanese cuisine, with a menu that extends well beyond the classic mezze experience. The meticulously crafted and finely balanced dishes impress in terms of freshness and authenticity. Whether you opt for hummus, sambousek jebneh (fried filo pastry rolls filled with sheep's-milk cheese) or subtly spiced grilled specialities such as kafta meshwi (minced veal and lamb skewer), it's best to come with friends, as many of the dishes are ideal for sharing. Attentive service and Lebanese wines round off the Middle Eastern culinary experience. In the evenings, live piano music adds to the atmosphere.
